author: The Current
description:
Watch Gogol Bordello playing songs from their 2026 album live in studio
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Combining the sounds of punk rock, electronica and Eastern European folk, New York-based rock band Gogol Bordello are always pushing new musical boundaries. Their latest album, We Mean It, Man!, released on February 13, 2026, and it continues to showcase the band’s ever-growing sound. 

Shortly after the album’s release, Gogol Bordello visited The Current studio for a session hosted by Jill Riley. Watch the full session above, which includes interviews with the band members between songs.

Video Segments
00:00:45 Ignition
00:05:24 interview with host Jill Riley, part 1
00:10:30 Life Is Possible Again
00:13:55 interview with host Jill Riley, part 2
00:17:40 Boiling Point
All songs from Gogol Bordello’s 2026 album, "We Mean It, Man!," available on Casa Gogol Records.

Musicians
Eugene Hütz – vocals, guitar
Sergey Ryabtsev – vocals, electr
title: Gogol Bordello play songs from "We Mean It, Man!" live at The Current
